title: A Drawer, a Warehouse and Me
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·行为习惯与自我管理）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·行为习惯与自我管理）　|　核心词汇：order　|　正文 305 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 order 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: When I first moved into the boarding school, my life had no ① order at all. Books, socks and biscuits shared one drawer, and I could waste twenty minutes hunting for a pen. My roommate Mei was the opposite. Every evening she put her desk ② in order before she slept: dictionary on the left, notebook in the middle, tomorrow's plan pinned to the wall.

'How do you keep it up?' I asked. She told me about her father, who works in a warehouse. Two days before New Year the shop received a large ③ order of goods, and during the sale the shop floor lost all ④ order: customers pushed, boxes fell, nobody knew which queue was which. The manager ⑤ ordered everyone to stay on, but first he asked them to sort the boxes into a clear ⑥ order so that nobody would move the same box twice.

I tried to copy Mei's method. For the first week my alarm clock was ⑦ out of order, so I overslept twice. Then I put the clock on the other side of the room ⑧ in order to force myself to get up. That small trick worked better than any speech about self-discipline. Ten days later the habit had held: I was up before the bell.

The hardest part was the phone. ⑨ In order not to lose a whole evening to short videos, I made a rule: the phone stays in the drawer until the homework is done. This is not an ⑩ order from my parents; it is one I give myself.

Six months later my desk looks different, and so does my mind. A tidy drawer is not the goal by itself. What matters is the habit of deciding, every evening, what comes first — the way a good manager puts a warehouse in order before the busy season, not during it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 秩序；安定（公共秩序）
C. n. 命令；指示（名词）
E. n. 条理；整齐（整洁的状态）
G. 固定搭配：in order to do 为了做某事
H. 固定搭配：out of order （机器）出故障

items.q: my life had no order at all
she put her desk in order
the shop floor lost all order
The manager ordered everyone to stay on
sort the boxes into a clear order
my alarm clock was out of order
in order to force myself to get up
In order not to lose a whole evening
not an order from my parents

answers.why: 与后半句“东西乱塞、找笔要找二十分钟”对照，指生活毫无“条理”。
put sth in order 指把书桌收拾“整齐”，后面列举的摆放位置是证据。
receive a large order of goods，商家“接到一大笔订单”，与货物 goods 搭配。
与 customers pushed、boxes fell、queue 呼应，指卖场“秩序”全乱了。
order sb to do sth，manager 作主语、everyone 作宾语，取动词“命令；吩咐”。
sort ... into an order，指按一定“顺序”把箱子分类，为的是不重复搬运。
out of order 指机器“出故障”，正因如此“我”才睡过了两次。
in order to do 表目的，“为了强迫自己起床”才把闹钟放远。
in order not to do 是 in order to 的否定式，“为了不把整晚丢给短视频”。
与后半句 it is one I give myself 对照，指这不再是父母下的“命令”，而是自己定的。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 他的房间总是收拾得整整齐齐。（in order）
我们为了赶上第一班公交车起得很早。（in order to）
这台打印机出故障了，请用另一台。（out of order）
经理吩咐我们下班前把货架整理好。（order sb to do）
这些箱子请按大小顺序摆放。（order）
春节期间这家商店接到了一大笔订单。（order）
answers: His room is always kept in order.
We got up early in order to catch the first bus.
This printer is out of order; please use the other one.
The manager ordered us to tidy the shelves before we left.
Please put these boxes in order of size.
The shop received a large order during the Spring Festival.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 order 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: At the beginning of last term I could not manage my time, and my desk was never in order.
My roommate made a plan for every evening in order to keep a steady rhythm of study.
When my alarm clock went out of order, I overslept and missed the first class.
Self-discipline is not an order from others; it is a habit that I repeat until it becomes natural.
In response to my teacher's advice, I put the phone away in order not to lose a whole evening.
A person who can control his own behaviour will slowly bring order to everything he does.
